_doc: DEFAULT-DENY. Only paths listed in `public` are ever copied HQ→public. A file NOT matched here stays private automatically — adding a new doc/feature never leaks until someone explicitly lists it. Globs: `**` = any depth, `*` = within a segment. Edit deliberately; every line is a decision to open-source that path.
